technical_and_design_decisions: Port XD modules (router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, gemfire) to standalone Spring Cloud Stream applications utilizing standard `@EnableBinding` configurations and Spring Boot starter conventions.
Refactor legacy Spring XD XML and property-based configurations into Spring Boot `@ConfigurationProperties` and Java-based configuration.
Upgrade build scripts (Gradle/Maven) to reference the latest compatible HDP and PHD distribution versions for HDFS modules, resolving transitive dependency conflicts.
Structure unit and integration tests using Spring Boot Test and Spring Cloud Stream Test support, leveraging embedded servers/testcontainers where applicable.
assumptions: Source code and specifications for the existing Spring XD modules are readily accessible.
The developer possesses working knowledge of both Spring XD module architectures and Spring Cloud Stream paradigms.
Test environments or mocks for external services (Redis, RabbitMQ, GemFire, FTP, HDP/HDFS) can be instantiated locally or in CI.
Documentation will be authored in AsciiDoc/Markdown to fit the existing repository's documentation toolchain.

activities.activity_description: Migrate the router module from Spring XD to spring-cloud-stream repository, converting it to a sink module with Spring Boot configuration and unit tests.
Migrate the file sink module from Spring XD to spring-cloud-stream repository, configuring Spring Integration file writing options and verifying file output tests.
Migrate the FTP sink module to spring-cloud-stream repository, updating Spring Integration FTP adapters and writing integration tests against an embedded or mock FTP server.
Move and refactor the Redis sink module to spring-cloud-stream repository, updating Spring Data Redis configurations and verifying against Redis instances.
Move and refactor the RabbitMQ source module to spring-cloud-stream repository, adapting AMQP inbound adapters and adding tests for message consumption.
Move and adapt the GemFire sink module to spring-cloud-stream repository, updating Spring Data GemFire dependencies, region bindings, and integration tests.
Update Hadoop distribution dependencies (HDP/PHD) to latest supported versions in HDFS modules, resolving dependency conflicts and testing HDFS pipelines.
Write a comprehensive documentation section detailing the migration path from 1.2 to 1.3 releases, highlighting improvements and backward-incompatible changes.
